Good roguelite shooter with fast movement. 
Pros:
 - the game feels quite polished for an early access title, it runs well and the visuals are nice and solid
 - the movement is fast, fluid and twitchy, you have a double jump, a dodge, can bounce off enemies' heads and grind on rails
 - the shooting feels very good, the weapons don't lose precision with your movement so you can jump and dash everywhere while chaining headshots, which is very rewarding
 - the weapons look nice and there's a good variety of them
 - many levels have a lot of verticality to take advantage of the movement
 - the enemies' attacks are projectile based, so they can be dodged with good movement
 - the bosses are enjoyable to fight, they have consistent patterns that demand quick reflexes
Cons:
 - there isn't a lot of content at the moment
 - the build/class variety is very limited
 - the enemies are a bit samey, and they don't tend to move around a lot
 - the levels consist of a narrow, linear path with some optional branches (except the last level which is very open)
